extraction_method.reason: All three PDFs confirmed to have clean embedded text layers (1,400-2,200 chars/page average across full documents) via a pre-extraction probe before committing to a pipeline.
extraction_method.encoding_note: PyMuPDF renders some apostrophes/em-dashes as the replacement glyph in raw terminal output on this Windows cp1252 console; this is a display/font-decode artifact of the source PDF's font encoding, not a corrupt capture. Content meaning is unaffected and was cross-checked by eye against the worked numeric examples (all arithmetic in source.md was independently verified: e.g. 17-10=7, 20-11=9, 11-10=1).

capture_contents.source.md: Verbatim quoted combat-resolution rules text (melee, shooting, damage, critical hits, modifier caps) from all three books, with page citations and worked examples, structured to answer the six research questions on the McCullough single-roll engine.
